title: Booksigning in New York Saturday Nov. 26
content: For those of you in New York who would like to meet me and get a copy of the new20th Anniversary edition of Dinotopiasigned and personalized, I'll be joining the "Holiday Kickoff" event on Sunday, November 26th from 12:00 - 2:00 atBooks of Wonderin NYC.Also on hand for the signing will be: JERRY PINKNEY, ED YOUNG, DAVID WIESNER, HILARY KNIGHT, MELISSA SWEET, SUSAN JEFFERS, LEO and DIANE DILLON, and CHARLES SANTORE.Books of Wonder is at 18 W. 18th Street. The store's phone number is 212-989-3270.Books of Wonder's website
